title: Beating GPT-5.6 Sol on retrieval with 100x cheaper open models
summary: Neon demonstrates that their castform solution achieves comparable retrieval performance to frontier models like GPT-4 while using open-source models that are 100x cheaper, focusing on database-integrated AI inference that reduces latency and costs for production applications.
problem_solved: Addresses the high cost and latency of using frontier AI models for retrieval tasks in production database environments.
why_valuable: Enables developers to build AI-powered applications with enterprise-grade performance at a fraction of the cost using commodity hardware and open models.
